name: empty
title: Empty
description: What a view shows when it has nothing to show yet.
use: A list, a table or a panel with no items, or a search with no matches. It says what belongs here and offers the action that fills it. It has no surface of its own: put it in a card, a well or on the page.

instead.when: The content exists and is still loading
The view failed to load and the reader needs the reason

classes.name: empty-media
classes.description: A well for an icon that names the kind of thing that is missing

classes.name: empty-title
classes.description: The state in plain words, such as "No deployments yet"

classes.name: empty-description
classes.description: How the view fills, in one or two sentences; it wraps at 24rem

example:
No deployments yet

Push to the main branch, or deploy from the dashboard, and the deployment appears here.
